title: Enabling Efficient GPU Communication over Multiple NICs with FuseLink
problem: Existing ML cluster systems with multiple NICs per server fail to fully utilize all NICs due to static GPU-NIC bindings, creating bottlenecks at hot-spot NICs when handling imbalanced communication patterns across LLM serving instances, expert-parallel training, and recommendation model training.
motivation: Multiple NICs are deployed to increase inter-server GPU communication bandwidth, but static bindings prevent full utilization and waste available bandwidth.
method: FuseLink extends the inter-server network by integrating high-speed intra-server connections and leverages GPUs as relay points to dynamically route traffic to idle NICs. It integrates into NCCL to enable seamless adoption by ML applications without code modifications.
key_novelty: Using GPUs as dynamic relay points to overcome static GPU-NIC bindings and redistribute traffic to underutilized NICs.
contributions: FuseLink system architecture with GPU-assisted relay mechanism for dynamic traffic routing
Integration with NCCL for transparent ML application adoption without code changes
Intra-server high-speed connections integrated with inter-server network
Empirical improvements across LLM serving (1.04-2.73x), MoE training (1.3x), and recommendation models (1.2x)
primary_theme: Multi-NIC GPU communication for ML clusters
